title: Arctix Men's 1960 Insulated Snowsports Cargo Pants, Black (Small/32" Inseam)

writeup: Arctix's 1960 snow sports cargo pants in black, men's small with a 32-inch inseam, are $7.99 on Woot. They're new, insulated with 85g ThermaTech, and have built-in boot gaiters.
